info.name: Incident Management - flows
info.description:
Two end-to-end flows with tests; run each folder top to bottom in the Collection Runner (or newman). Start the app with the seed profile (see README). The caller is the X-User-Id header: a username (ada, alice, bob, carol, dan, erin) or a user id. {{bob}} = bob; {{bobId}} etc. hold the ids. Folders are independent and re-runnable.

1. Reporter (bob, no team).
2. Team member (dan, Database team).

item.name: 1. Reporter flow (bob)

exec: pm.test('Database team is there', () => pm.expect(body.map(t => t.name)).to.include('Database'));

request.description: The category decides the owning team, whose members are emailed.

exec: pm.test('owned by Database, reported by Bob', () => { pm.expect(body.teamId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('teamDatabase')); pm.expect(body.reporterId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('bobId')); });

item.name: A reporter may not report SEV1 (409)

exec: pm.test('name changed', () => pm.expect(body.title).to.eql('Checkout and login are slow'));

pm.test('history has INCIDENT_CREATED, DETAILS_UPDATED, COMMENT_ADDED', () => { const a = body.map(e => e.action); ["INCIDENT_CREATED", "DETAILS_UPDATED", "COMMENT_ADDED"].forEach(x => pm.expect(a).to.include(x)); });

item.name: A reporter may not change the status (403)
Another user may not edit my incident (403)

item.description: Bob has no team; his Database-category incident is owned by the Database team (alice, dan).

item.name: 2. Team member flow (dan, Database team)

request.description: Setup: Bob reports the incident this part of the flow works on.

exec: pm.test('Dan is a member of Database', () => pm.expect(body.find(t => t.name === 'Database').members.map(m => m.userId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('danId')));

item.name: Review sends it back to work (-> IN_PROGRESS)
A resolved incident takes no comments (409)
Team incidents list it as CLOSED

exec: pm.test('history has INCIDENT_CREATED, STATUS_CHANGED, COMMENT_ADDED, DETAILS_UPDATED, ESCALATED, DE_ESCALATED', () => { const a = body.map(e => e.action); ["INCIDENT_CREATED", "STATUS_CHANGED", "COMMENT_ADDED", "DETAILS_UPDATED", "ESCALATED", "DE_ESCALATED"].forEach(x => pm.expect(a).to.include(x)); });

item.name: Escalate SEV2 -> SEV1 and hand over to Platform

exec: pm.test('Platform owns it, OPEN for them', () => { pm.expect(body.teamId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('teamPlatform')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('OPEN'); });

item.name: Rename, escalate and acknowledge in one PATCH

exec: pm.test('all three applied', () => { pm.expect(body.title).to.eql('Primary DB rejects writes'); pm.expect(body.severity).to.eql('SEV1'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('IN_PROGRESS'); });

item.name: History: the three changes share one correlation id

exec: pm.test('history has DETAILS_UPDATED, ESCALATED, STATUS_CHANGED', () => { const a = body.map(e => e.action); ["DETAILS_UPDATED", "ESCALATED", "STATUS_CHANGED"].forEach(x => pm.expect(a).to.include(x)); });
pm.test('one correlation id', () => { const ids = body.filter(e => e.action !== 'INCIDENT_CREATED').map(e => e.correlationId); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(1); });
